fraction_conservation.name: fraction_conservation
fraction_conservation.value: "inventory_movements"."kind"<>'fraction' or ("inventory_movements"."counted_before" is not null and "inventory_movements"."delivered_pieces" is not null and "inventory_movements"."remaining_pieces" is not null and "inventory_movements"."counted_before">0 and "inventory_movements"."delivered_pieces">=0 and "inventory_movements"."remaining_pieces">=0 and "inventory_movements"."counted_before"="inventory_movements"."delivered_pieces"+"inventory_movements"."remaining_pieces")

payment_currency_rate.name: payment_currency_rate
payment_currency_rate.value: ("payments"."currency"='USD' and "payments"."bcv_rate_id" is null and "payments"."amount"="payments"."amount_usd") or ("payments"."currency"='VES' and "payments"."bcv_rate_id" is not null)

public.receivables.definition: select s.id as sale_id, s.client_id, s.number, s.due_date, 'USD'::text as currency, coalesce(l.total,0)::numeric(18,2) as total_usd, coalesce(p.paid,0)::numeric(18,2) as paid_usd, (coalesce(l.total,0)-coalesce(p.paid,0))::numeric(18,2) as balance_usd from sales s left join (select sale_id, round(sum(quantity*agreed_unit_usd),2) as total from sale_lines group by sale_id) l on l.sale_id=s.id left join (select sale_id,sum(amount_usd) as paid from payment_applications group by sale_id) p on p.sale_id=s.id where s.status='confirmed'
public.receivables.name: receivables
